yamlCheck.dateAnchor: Only May 30 at dawn is spoken as a civil date. Its year is supplied by YAML; the opening May 24 date is not independently stated.
yamlCheck.explanation: The narrated opening is continuous with the previous battle and advances about thirty minutes before the last fight; afterward four explicit daily advances end at May 30 dawn. The six-boundary YAML span therefore has two days not established by this transcript. Counting the four advances backward would put the battle on May 26 if they were exhaustive, but the opening date is not independently spoken. Missing elapsed coverage is not by itself proof of a contradictory date; do not fill the gap from drEnd or silently adopt the conditional May 26 reading.
